issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

id.description: The unique and required id of this instance.

defaultContentUrl.description: If present, the user will be redirected to this url instead of the idp login page.

userIdFormat.description: Which field of the IdpUser to use as the user id

defaultGroupId.description:
The default group to assign to users upon successful authentication.
Security leveled groups are not permitted.

idpWriteback.description: Returns whether we should write back to the Idp

idpGroupWriteback.description: Returns whether we should write back {@link UserGroup} updates to the Idp

idpType.description: Returns the identity provider for write-back (if enabled)

externalAppId.description:
The external authentication application ID that this IdpConfig is associated with.
This is used to identify the application in the IdP ex: okta app id.

allowedEmailDomains.description:
List of allowed email domains that users can have to be able to login.
The email domain is everything after the '@' in the email address.
If empty, then no email domain validation is done on user login.

trustedApplicationHosts.description: Applications that are trusted to redirect authenticated user(s)

relevantGroups.description: List of relevant groups for the cluster from the IDP. If empty, then no group filtering is done on user login.
